source_inspections.bounded_subject: Personal information, purpose and end-to-end privacy
source_inspections.decision_reason: Conversations, identity, preferences, workspace observations, generated interests and linked or inferred information can identify people. Local processing does not remove their purpose, minimization, access, correction, retention, disclosure and recovery obligations.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Subjects, purpose, processing, inference, minimization and rights
Authority, sharing, protected data, derivative copies and policy enforcement
Correction, deletion, accessible remedies, incident response and lifecycle evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Establish actual purposes, subjects, authority, necessary fields and retention horizons before access/disclosure. Scope source payloads, indexes, embeddings, caches, prompts, logs, exports, models, backups and restored copies separately. Access/correction/objection/export/deletion and appeal must remain usable without AI. No jurisdiction, legal basis, universal forgetting or consent is inferred from location or a button. The memory binding below checks metadata only; actual authorized access and verified copy outcomes remain open.
source_inspections.reopening_condition: Material change to actual use, scope, data, subject, authority, device/physical lane, model, policy, supplier, evidence or lifecycle.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Current authority and auditable governed execution
source_inspections.decision_reason: The unified kernel, policy, capability, trace and immutable decision determine admissibility at the actual boundary. Existing descriptions and named AI roles do not establish current permission or delegate the user's decision authority.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Decision rights, ownership, source precedence and immutable records
Policy, delegation, quorum, expiry, revocation, admission and effect authority
Denial, appeal, compensation, recovery and attributable lifecycle evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Bind actual authority evidence, policy versions, exact operation/resources, validity and quorum to every consequential transition; deny stale or forged claims and preserve success, failure, cancellation and recovery history. No model or graph role self-authorizes. Current owner instructions authorize this reversible implementation; historical AI-governance wording neither locks code nor creates an extra approval gate. Authentic policy adoption, signatures, quorum, appeals and runtime enforcement remain unfinished.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Supplied-source, license, policy and delivery compliance
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA has supplied source constraints, provenance, dependency/license and declared delivery obligations that require traceability. Whether a particular external law, contract or certification applies requires an actual identified scope and authority.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Sources, obligations, version/effective date, scope and accountable owners
Policy, privacy, custody, third-party supply and controlled change
Designed versus operating controls, evidence, exceptions and reassessment

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Keep obligation identity, source, version, effective date, jurisdiction if established, owner, control, evidence validity, exception and review distinct. Designed, implemented, operating, effective, assessed, certified and accepted are separate states. No statute, regulated domain, certification body or legal acceptance is invented; supplied doctrine is not automatically law. Resolve real external terms with their actual sources when selected, without importing another personal repository or treating source tests as compliance.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Software consequence hazards and retained physical safety lanes
source_inspections.decision_reason: Data loss, unintended effects, misleading decisions, unavailable stop/recovery, rights impacts and the explicitly retained device/actuator lanes create material consequence hazards. A software-only development step does not discharge those hazards.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Hazard context, intended use, misuse and protected outcomes
Independent stop/interlocks, authority, reserves and recoverable containment
Safety evidence, qualification, residual risk and lifecycle review

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Identify scoped hazards and credible compound failures, including stale state, model and human error, uncertainty and common causes. Preserve independent protected stop, actual interlocks, accessible alarms and manual recovery when nonessential AI fails. Hazard identification, written control, implemented control, verification and accepted residual risk remain distinct. No qualified safety specialist, probability or owner risk acceptance is fabricated; physical action remains unavailable until its real controls are qualified.
source_inspections.reopening_condition: Material change to actual use, scope, data, subject, authority, device/physical lane, model, policy, supplier, evidence or lifecycle.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Dependable outcomes over declared conditions and time
source_inspections.decision_reason: Persistent tasks, memory, authority, user data and effects must remain correct under actual workload, resource, maintenance and failure conditions over time. Uptime or a passing unit suite does not demonstrate outcome reliability.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Workload, conditions, failure definitions, dependencies and reliability targets
Failure detection, repair, custody, reconciliation, migration and recovery
Retained failures, measurements, installed behavior and real endurance

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Declare actual workload, exposure, time horizon, failure definition, common cause and repair assumptions. Retain raw semantic failures, timeouts and data loss rather than hiding them in availability averages. Targets, predictions, tests, measurements, operating history and risk acceptance are separate. Measure installed behavior and seven actual elapsed days after prerequisites; no reliability probability or confidence is manufactured from counts.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Protected outcomes, degraded operation and verified recovery
source_inspections.decision_reason: The product must preserve stop, settlement, evidence and recoverability across worker, model, identity, storage, supplier, network and human failures. Restarting one process is not proof that the affected user outcome has recovered.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Critical outcomes, degradation modes, thresholds and decision rights
Control/data loss, authority, compensating actions and accessible recovery
Compound disruptions, recovery outcomes, learning and lifecycle evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Describe protected outcomes and usable alternatives under compound disruption. Separate redundant names from independent capacity and measured recovery. Preserve non-AI stop, status, manual correction and recovery; provider loss cannot silently send private context externally. Reconcile uncertain effects, restoration and actual user impact. Compensation is new governed work with preserved history. Recovery thresholds and verified outcomes remain open; no business-continuity or production resilience certification is asserted.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Accessible native workflows, denial and recovery

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Users, tasks, semantics, perception, navigation and alternative modalities
Accessible review, time limits, errors, correction, support and recovery
Actual assistive-technology/user validation and release lifecycle

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Qualify native keyboard, focus, screen-reader semantics, zoom, timing and alternative input on an actual supported device/assistive-technology matrix. Consent, denial, stop, correction and recovery need understandable status and usable actions without AI. Apply captions/transcripts to real voice lanes. Actual populations and accommodations are not inferred from this user's messages. No automated scan substitutes for user validation, and no particular accessibility statute or conformance level is silently adopted.

source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA creates user-facing answers, explanations, documents, generated proposals, citations and evidence. Their source, audience, purpose, rights, versions, approval and correction matter independently of fluent wording or visual presentation.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Audience, purpose, source, claims, format and content identity
Rights, sensitivity, draft/approval/publication and accessible correction
Evidence, comprehension, revision, withdrawal and maintained delivery artifacts

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Separate source, draft, approved, rendered, translated, cached, published and evidence versions. Preserve actual author/source/date/rights, generated and uncertain status, citations, corrections and earlier history. Honor exact requested formats, exclusions, negations and current corrections in ordinary local answers. A draft is not authority to publish externally. Content truth, comprehension, accessibility, copyright and actual review remain unqualified; polish and pure metadata tests do not establish them.
